notes: v6.6.1 — Fix Muse CDP login detection (root cause of 'Muse API not connected' despite Edge being logged in). The muse.top API gateway requires an AuthToken JWT header in addition to App-Key; cookies alone return code=1006. museCdpBridge.js: added extractAuthToken() which probes localStorage/sessionStorage for the JWT (supports multiple key names + nested userInfo JSON), caches it, and injects it as the AuthToken header on every fetchFromEdge call. checkLogin now returns full memberInfo (evaluationCreditPaid/NoPaid, totalCredits, membershipExpired). muse.controller.js: ensureCDP + museCallViaCDP extract and pass the token, with rich diagnostic logging (tokenFound/tokenSource/pageOrigin/raw response). vite.config.js: add fs.deny for edge_profile/.git/.history and restrict optimizeDeps.entries to index.html so Vite's esbuild scanner never crawls browser-profile JS. Verified: GET /api/muse/status now returns loggedIn=true with totalCredits=40.
